description.en: The name of the application to which the stream belongs.

description.zh:
主播流域名。
> - 传入DomainName时，请保证传入域名为直播域名，同时调用本接口的用户拥有传入域名的操作权限。
description.en:
The streaming domain of the streamer.
> - When you specify DomainName, make sure that the domain name is a live streaming domain name and that the user who calls this operation has the permissions to operate on the specified domain name.

description.zh: 结束时间。EndTime和StartTime之间的间隔不能超过**1**天。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。
description.en: The end time. The interval between EndTime and StartTime cannot exceed **1** day. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC).

description.zh: 一次调用获取的数量。取值范围：**1~100**， 默认值：**10**。
description.en: The number of entries to return in a single call. Valid values: **1 to 100**. Default value: **10**.

description.zh:
排序。取值：

- **asc**（默认值）：升序。
- **desc**：降序。
description.en:
The sort order. Valid values:

- **asc** (default): ascending order.
- **desc**: descending order.

description.zh: 播流名称，请确保传入的流名在查询时间段内是存在的。
description.en: The name of the stream. Make sure that the specified stream name exists within the query time range.

title.zh: 查询一段时间内截图内容
title.en: Query snapshot content within a time range

descriptions.zh:
调用本接口仅支持查询一年内的截图数据。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
You can call this operation to query snapshot data only within the last year.

## QPS limit
The single-user QPS limit for this operation is 100 calls per second. If this limit is exceeded, the API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Call this operation appropriately.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-stream-snapshot-info --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --stream-name liveStream0000 --start-time 2017-12-21T08:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-22T08:00:00Z --limit 10 --order asc --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DescribeLiveStreamSnapshotInfo --region cn-hangzhou --Order asc --StreamName liveStream0000 --EndTime '2017-12-22T08:00:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --StartTime '2017-12-21T08:00:00Z' --Limit 10 --AppName liveApp0000
